name: PEMS08: Caltrans District 8 Spatial-Temporal Highway Traffic Flow
description: PEMS08 is a spatial-temporal traffic flow dataset sourced from the Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS) for District 8 (San Bernardino area). Introduced alongside PEMS04 in ASTGCN (AAAI 2019), it compiles traffic measurements from 170 loop detectors recorded at 5-minute intervals from July 1 to August 31, 2016 (17,856 timestamps), measuring traffic flow, occupancy, and speed.
